ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Жизнь истинная только в настоящем» (zhizn' istinnaya tol'ko v nastoyashchem, 'true life is only in the present') keeps the terminology pairing of «истинная» (istinnaya, 'true') with «настоящее» (nastoyashchee, 'the present'); «служение» (sluzhenie, 'service') is repeated as in the source. The attribution «По Карлейлю» (po Karleylyu) is 'After Carlyle.', not the website's expanded 'Thomas Carlyle'.
